request.description:

exec: try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { console.log('Response is not valid JSON:', error.message); }

pm.test('A-STU-036 JWT role claim matches persisted user.role', function () {var b = pm.response.json();var parts = (b.token || '').split('.');pm.expect(parts.length, 'JWT has three segments').to.eql(3);var payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(parts[1], 'base64').toString('utf8'));pm.expect(payload.role, 'token role equals response role').to.eql(b.user.role);pm.expect(payload.id, 'token id equals response id').to.eql(b.user.id);});

request.description:

exec: pm.test('A-STU-037 unknown email and wrong password are indistinguishable', function () {var known = pm.response;pm.sendRequest({url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{base_url}}/api/login'), method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Student-Id': pm.variables.replaceIn('{{student_id}}')}, body: {mode:'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({email:'no.such.user.hw06@example.com', password:'WrongPassword!'})}}, function (err, unknown) {pm.expect(err).to.equal(null);pm.expect(unknown.code, 'same status for unknown email vs wrong password').to.eql(known.code);pm.expect(unknown.text(), 'same body for unknown email vs wrong password').to.eql(known.text());});});
